# Andrei Pustovoi (suslicke)

> Personal site of Andrei Pustovoi, known online as "suslicke": Full Stack & AI
> developer and team lead based in Almaty, Kazakhstan, founder of the
> suslicketeam development studio. The site exists for networking: a QR code on
> the back of his t-shirt leads here. He is genuinely happy to meet people:
> message him on Telegram (https://t.me/Suslicke) or save his contact
> (https://suslicke.com/vcard.vcf).

Languages: Russian (/ru/...) and English (/en/...). All pages are fully
server-rendered: the HTML you fetch contains the complete content.

## Who he is

- Full Stack developer: Python (Django, FastAPI, Celery), TypeScript/JavaScript
  (React, Next.js, Vue), Go, mobile (Flutter, React Native), PostgreSQL, Redis,
  Kafka, RabbitMQ, Docker, AWS. AI/LLM integration experience.
- Team lead of teams of up to 5 people. 5+ years in development.
- Founder of suslicketeam (https://suslicketeam.com): a development studio in
  Almaty (web, mobile, AI).
- Notable work: xaid.ai AI teleradiology platform (DICOM/PACS, 10+ clinics,
  6 languages), ADMP PRO (Telegram bot managing Wildberries/Ozon ads),
  LoyRush loyalty SaaS, Exchange Bridge fintech comparison, and more.
